fact: The National Cybersecurity Strategy 2023-2026 sets a governance framework under the Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021 with a National Cybersecurity Committee and CERT-MU as national CERT.
title: National Cybersecurity Strategy 2023-2026: For a more secure and resilient Mauritius
publisher: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation / CERT-MU
